name: Model Protein Dimerization Network
description: Model protein dimerization networks to find equilibrium concentrations of dimers.
detailed_description: Model protein dimerization networks to find equilibrium concentrations of dimers.
when_to_use: When you need model protein dimerization network analysis

parameters.monomer_concentrations: [Required] Dictionary mapping monomer names to their initial concentrations (in arbitrary units) (dict)
parameters.dimerization_affinities: [Required] Dictionary mapping dimer names (as 'A-B' strings) to their association constants (Ka) (dict)
parameters.network_topology: [Required] List of (monomer1, monomer2) pairs that can form dimers (list)
